turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: She worries about the future, doesn't she? I will ensure everything is as she wishes, Father. The maid and I will do our best.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Your mother… she always thinks of everything, doesn’t she? It’s good that you are taking care of things, son, and that you and the maid will see to it all, just as she asks. I’ll… I’ll be here, watching over her.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: The maid is capable, Father. I believe she will manage well. We will, of course, follow Mother’s instructions carefully.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It’s… it’s a comfort to know you’re both thinking of her wishes, son. I trust you both will do what is right, and… and that you’ll remember her guidance, always. She has a good heart, your mother, and wants only what is best for the family.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: I understand, Father. We will not forget her concerns. I am certain we can fulfill her expectations.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: It is important that we all remain strong, Father. I will speak with the steward about the arrangements; everything will be handled properly.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: It’s… it’s a heavy burden, these instructions, isn't it, son? I trust you'll be able to bear it, and that you and the maid will be able to… to see them through, as your mother wishes. I only want what’s best for my family, and I believe you both do too.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Now she will be well, yet!

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Well, and if I am ugly, [GE-OMITTED:50:aa] [GE-OMITTED:51:aa]
